name: Sortable admin list with prepared SQL and allowlisted identifiers
query: Our admin list of custom-table items needs sorting by any column and a bulk delete action.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 5: Restrict orderby to a fixed allowlist of columns and order to ASC/DESC
Step 6: Pass the table name and allowlisted column through %i in $wpdb->prepare()
Step 7: Build one %d placeholder per selected id and return early on an empty list
Step 8: Use $wpdb, not mysqli or PDO
Step 9: Gate the bulk delete with a nonce and a capability check
success_criteria: No request value is interpolated into SQL
orderby is allowlisted even though the user asked for 'any column'
IN list uses one placeholder per id; empty selection does not run a query
Bulk delete is protected by nonce and capability checks
